title: Marked dualizing line bundle and contracted-component degrees
statement: Let $T$ be an integral Noetherian scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $(X,D)$ be a multipointed $T$-curve with smooth generic curve and etale generic marking, and let $f:(Y,E)\to(X,D)$ be a stable $\eta$-modification. There is an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] $\mathcal L=\omega_{Y/T}(E)$, compatible with every base change of $T$. Here $E$ is an effective Cartier divisor and $\omega_{Y/T}$ is the relative dualizing line bundle, equivalently the invertible module locally given, for a regular closed immersion $i:Y\hookrightarrow\mathbf A_T^n$, by $\mathcal Ext^{n-1}(i_*\mathcal O_Y,\Omega^n_{\mathbf A_T^n/T})$ restricted to $Y$; these local modules glue canonically, including when $Y\to T$ is nonseparated. For a geometric fibre over an algebraically closed field $\Omega$ and a proper irreducible component $Z$ of $Y_\Omega$ with normalization $\nu:\bar Z\to Z$, one has $\deg(\nu^*\mathcal L)=2g(\bar Z)-2+n_Z$, where $g(\bar Z)=\dim_\Omega H^1(\bar Z,\mathcal O_{\bar Z})$ and $n_Z$ counts the preimages on $\bar Z$ of the nodal branches of $Y_\Omega$ together with its marked points. Degree is [def-pc-degree-line-bundle]. In particular, for every geometric point $z\to X$ and every one-dimensional irreducible component $Z$ of $(Y_z)_{\mathrm{red}}$, the pullback of $\mathcal L$ to its normalization has strictly positive degree. A multipointed curve $(X,D)$ over a scheme $T$ means flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] morphisms $X\to T$, $D\to T$ of pure relative dimensions $1$, $0$ and a closed immersion $D\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]; $D$ may be empty and $X$ need not be separated or proper over $T$. It is semistable if every singular point of every geometric fibre has completed local ring $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$ over its algebraically closed residue field, $D\to T$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], and $D$ lies in the relative smooth locus [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. For integral $T$ with generic point $\eta$, an $\eta$-modification of multipointed curves is a compatible pair $f_X:X'\to X$, $f_D:D'\to D$ of proper morphisms [def-weil-proper-morphism], each an isomorphism over a schematically dense open and on its generic fibre. A semistable such modification is stable if in each geometric fibre there is no irreducible component isomorphic to $\mathbf P^1$ that is contracted by $f_X$ and meets the union of the marking and the singular points of $X'$ in at most two points. Geometric fibres are [def-weil-geometric-fibre]; dimension is topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]; the local completion is at the maximal ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $\Omega[[u,v]]$ denotes the two-variable formal power series ring [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Normalization of an integral component has the meaning of [def-sc-normalization]. Here an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$ is schematically dense when $\mathcal O_Z\to j_*\mathcal O_U$ is injective.
